name: @open-design/closure-shim
description: Shell-carried ensure and handoff entry for Open Design Standalone Closure

scripts.build: pnpm --filter @open-design/closure-proto build && pnpm --filter @open-design/closure-store build && pnpm --filter @open-design/closure-update build && pnpm --filter @open-design/standalone-runtime build && tsx ./esbuild.config.ts && tsc -p tsconfig.json --emitDeclarationOnly
scripts.test: pnpm --filter @open-design/closure-proto build && pnpm --filter @open-design/closure-store build && pnpm --filter @open-design/closure-update build && pnpm --filter @open-design/standalone-runtime build && vitest run
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @open-design/closure-proto build && pnpm --filter @open-design/closure-store build && pnpm --filter @open-design/closure-update build && pnpm --filter @open-design/standalone-runtime build && tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.tests.json --noEmit
